items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 97:1
items.html: The vessels from the Chazeh downward are called by the name the externality of the Partzuf, because all the NHY are outside the body. And they are discerned as BYA. And first they divide into front and back, because the two lower thirds of Tifferet, being the discernment of the seven lower Sefirot of the Bina of the body, are called the front, since their diminution is not because of themselves but because they are a root for ZON. And the NHYM are called the backs, upon which falls the main exit outside Atzilut. Therefore there are two discernments of externality: first, the externality from the side of the front, which are the two lower thirds of Tifferet; second, the externality from the side of the back, which are the NHYM. And the Malchut in the externality from the side of the back is discerned by the name the externality of the externality of the back. Now, the externality from the side of the front became the place of Beriah; the externality from the side of the back, without the Malchut, became the place of the world of Yetzirah; and the externality of the externality of the back, which is the Malchut, became the place of Assiyah. (Item 1 and Item 5).
